extra_inning_runline_split_note: how often each side that won in extra innings won by two or more, read off the same extra-inning games as extra_inning_home_rate; the runline's share of the tie is tie_home times the home conditional and (1 - tie_home) times the away one; no prior is applied because the asymmetry is the walk-off and a pooled prior would erase it; served through SERVE_RUNLINE_TIE_SPLIT (owner decision 2026-09-11, ahead of the runline margin gate, which still decides its successor)
diff_shrink_note: run-differential shrink fitted by log loss on completed games; below 1.0 means the raw predictor separated clubs further than the results did, and the fair total is untouched by it
prob_calibration_note: Platt p' = sigmoid(a*logit(p) + b) on the moneyline only, docs/diamond-betting.md section 11b; served null until both gate arms pass, and the fitted pair is expected near identity because diff_shrink already absorbs the response scale in-sample

total_level_fitted.basis: vintage FIT half only (_vintage_cut_index), served coefficients and corrections on dated features; the eval half and the market are not read

total_dispersion_fitted.basis: vintage FIT half only (_vintage_cut_index), served coefficients and corrections on dated features; the eval half and the market are not read

total_calibration_fitted.basis: vintage FIT half only (_vintage_cut_index); the eval half and the market are not read

total_level_note: one additive constant on the Poisson TOTAL mean, fitted on the vintage fit half by over/under log loss at the fixed lines 7.5 to 10.5; the moneyline and the runline never read it. The model's mean total is right on that half; the constant corrects where a Poisson puts its middle, which is the mean, while real run totals split lower. docs/diamond-betting.md section 7f
run_dispersion_note: NB2 run dispersion, var = lam + alpha*lam^2, by conditional MLE on both scoring sides given the model's own lambda; Poisson (alpha 0) underdisperses real run scoring by a measured var/mean of 2.34 per side and 2.37 on the margin. Served only because the pre-registered four-criterion gate in docs/diamond-betting.md section 11 passed on a held-out half; `run_dispersion` in betting_model_eval.json carries it
home_field_note: the runs regression recovers almost no home field because a home team leading after the top of the ninth never bats; the adjustment restores the observed home win rate as a run differential, leaving the fair total unchanged
source_note: fit on completed games read out of .cache/game_feeds, offline; team inputs are season-to-date leaderboards, so this fit is IN-SAMPLE and cannot validate the model
